tellings.difference: Says the Virgin Mary told him to write it and that he took a long time to do so, which he regrets; it does not mention the Crillon or the Vatican's reply.
tellings.link_reason: Both are about the letter to the Pope that the Virgin Mary told Mowatt-Larssen to write.

as_told.title: Virgin Mary told him to write a letter to the Pope

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former senior officer at the CIA, the US foreign intelligence agency, says the Virgin Mary told him to write a letter to Pope John Paul II. He says it took him a long time to write, which he regrets, and that he finally sent it to the Vatican and got a reply. The story ties this to the night the Pope died in 2005, when he was at the Hotel Crillon in Paris, and he reproduces the letter in his book. If true, it would mean a message from a religious vision reached the head of the Catholic Church.
